title: Jin Mao Tower
visualBrief: Compact Jin Mao exterior preserves the mapped star-shaped base, twelve occupied setbacks, horizontal courses and eight crown stages. Far levels merge corner facets and glazing; closer levels restore fins and bracing. Detailed original master stays reproducible.
